name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
summary: An isolation exercise that builds shoulder width by raising dumbbells out to the sides to target the lateral deltoids.

setup: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides or resting lightly against your outer thighs.
Set a soft, fixed bend in your elbows and brace your core with your chest proud.
steps: Raise the dumbbells outward and upward in the plane of the scapula until your upper arms are approximately parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly at shoulder height, keeping your hands level with or slightly below your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells under control back to the starting position without letting them swing.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells out to the sides, and inhale as you lower them with control.
cues: Reach out toward the walls rather than straight up.
Keep your shoulders depressed away from your ears.

common_faults.fault: Swinging the torso or using leg drive to propel the dumbbells upward.
common_faults.correction: Reduce the load and keep your torso stationary throughout the entire repetition.

common_faults.fault: Shrugging the neck and upper traps excessively to lift the weights.
common_faults.correction: Keep your shoulder blades pulled down and focus the effort entirely on the lateral deltoids.

common_faults.fault: Raising the hands significantly higher than the elbows.
common_faults.correction: Ensure your elbows lead the movement and remain aligned with or slightly above your wrists.

precautions: Avoid aggressive internal rotation with pinkies raised excessively high, which can cause shoulder impingement.
